title: Prepare your first enrollment file
summary: Required fields, sample checks and handling rejected rows.
body: Confirm the agreed identifier and required fields before preparing a sample. Work from a copy, keep the original source, and reconcile accepted and rejected counts. Hold conflicting duplicate records for the client data owner; do not silently remove them. Record the approved correction rule and re-run validation.

title: Request access to a client workspace
summary: Name the workspace, required role and approving owner.
body: Submit the workspace name, business purpose and required role. The workspace owner approves the request before an administrator grants access. Verify the result with a test account using the approved role. Escalate missing ownership to the implementation lead.

title: Resolve duplicate enrollment identifiers
summary: Review conflicting rows and obtain an explicit correction decision.
body: Preserve the input file. Identify which fields conflict and ask the client data owner to approve the resolution rule. Correct a copy, re-run validation and reconcile the counts. Record the result in the issue log. This article is due for review; verify the current platform procedure before use.

title: Prepare a launch handoff
summary: Transfer support ownership with known issues and open actions.
body: Confirm required launch gates, accepted exceptions and client approval. Name the ongoing support owner and escalation route. Include current documentation links, known issues, open actions and the first post-launch review date. Ask the receiving owner to acknowledge the handoff.

title: Write a weekly project update
summary: State changes, blockers, decisions and owned next actions.
body: Begin with the outcome and any decision needed. Preserve blocked and pending statuses from the source notes. Name an owner and date for each action when confirmed; otherwise identify who will clarify the missing detail. Explain milestone impact without inventing a commitment.

title: Handle a rejected approval request
summary: Read the decision comment before preparing a new submission.
body: Review the reason and confirm whether additional information or a material change is needed. Preserve the original decision history. A corrected request starts a new review; do not change the original rejected record to Approved. Contact the workflow owner if the assigned approver is incorrect.

title: Review and archive a knowledge article
summary: Verify accuracy, update links and retain a clear replacement path.
body: The owner checks the procedure against the current product or process. Record the review and any substantive change. If retiring the article, retain its stable identifier and replacement link, update inbound references and preserve the last approved revision under the organization’s retention rules.

title: Legacy manual account request
body: This retired instruction is retained for traceability. Use KB-102, Request access to a client workspace, for the current demonstration process.
